name: bit
description_en: Fast, lightweight, resource-efficient, compiled URL shortener. `MIT` `Docker/Crystal`
description: Fast, lightweight, self-hosted URL shortener service with minimal click tracking
readme_preview:
- Minimal tracking setup: Country, browser, OS, referer. No cookies or persistent tracking mechanisms are used beyond what's available from a basic client's request. - Includes `X-Forwarded-For` header. - Multiple users are supported via API key authentication. Create, list and delete keys via the [CLI](docs/SETUP.md#cli). - Easy to extend, Ruby on Rails inspired setup. - Auto update UA regexes and GeoLite2 database.
